phrases.farsi: man tu khune se tâ gorbe dâram.
phrases.persian: من تو خونه سه تا گربه دارم.
phrases.english: I have three cats at home.
One of them is black and white.
The last one is black too.

phrases.farsi: diruz dâshtam bâ gorbehâ bâzi mikardam ke ye sedâyi shenidam.
phrases.persian: دیروز داشتم با گربه‌ها بازی می‌کردم که یه صدایی شنیدم.
phrases.english: Yesterday I was playing with the cats when I heard a noise.
The noise came from the street.
The people were angry and tired.

phrases.farsi: sâ’at-e shesh-e asr terâfik tamum shod.
phrases.persian: ساعت شش عصر ترافیک تموم شد.
phrases.english: At six in the evening, the traffic ended.

phrases.farsi: man raftam forushgâh tâ barâ gorbehâ ghazâ bekharam.
phrases.persian: من رفتم فروشگاه تا برا گربه‌ها غذا بخرم.
phrases.english: I went to the shop to buy food for the cats.

phrases.farsi: un forushgâh mamulan ghazâ-ye gorbe dâre vali diruz nadâsht.
phrases.persian: اون فروشگاه معمولاً غذای گربه داره ولی دیروز نداشت.
phrases.english: That shop usually has cat food, but yesterday it did not.
